test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following ministries launched a theme song 'Hawa Aane De' on air pollution in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Environment, forest and climate change.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Environment, forest, and climate change on 29th May launched the song “Thodi hawa aane de, taazi hawa aane de"​.**
 
• It was launched to spread awareness about Air pollution.
 
• **This song was launched by Secretary, Ministry of Environment CK Mishra.**
 
• The song urges people to be part of the solution and not add to the pollution.
 
• It offers solutions for clean and green travel which include switching to public transport, car-pooling, and turning off the engine at a traffic signal. 
 
• It was launched ahead of **World Environment Day** on the **5th of June.**
 
• The theme of Environment Day for 2019 was 'Air Pollution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ministry in collaboration with **Bhamla Foundation** has produced the anthem.
 
• Bhamla Foundation is a** Mumbai-based non-governmental organization (NGO).**
 
• For the anthem, actors **Akshay Kumar, Rajkummar Rao, Vicky Kaushal, comedian Kapil Sharma, choreographer Shiamak Davar, singers Shaan, Shankar Mahadevan, and Sunidhi Chauhan** came together.
 
• The song asks people to put a full stop to the burning of stubble and waste, and support eco-friendly industrialization. 
 
• The anthem further highlights how we don’t value the things we get easily or for free like air.
